description: Defines HTTP/3 frame types and associated data structures for QUIC protocol implementation, including Data, Headers, Settings, GoAway, PriorityUpdate, and AcceptCh frames.

classes.name: DataFrame
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 DATA frame containing arbitrary data.

classes.name: HeadersFrame
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 HEADERS frame carrying header block data.

classes.name: SettingsFrame
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 SETTINGS frame with configuration parameters.

classes.name: GoAwayFrame
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 GOAWAY frame used to initiate connection shutdown.

classes.name: PriorityUpdateFrame
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 PRIORITY_UPDATE frame indicating stream priority.

classes.name: AcceptChFrame
classes.description: Represents an ACCEPT_CH frame for HTTP client hints.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts frame data to a string representation.
